name: Progressive house
key_tendency: Minor keys with lush 7th chords (G minor: Gm7 Eb^7 Bb^7 F); warm, patient.
signature: Groove-first drums with a shaker running 16ths
Very slow filter sweep across 32 bars
A short pluck melody with long delay
Long, gradual builds, layers added every 8 or 16 bars
listen_for: Nothing happens suddenly: the chord filter opens over 32 bars and each section adds one layer. The shaker and offbeat stabs keep it swinging.

parts.bass:
const bass = note("<g1 eb1 bb1 f1>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~").s("sawtooth")
  .lpf(500).decay(0.2).sustain(0.1).gain(0.45)

starter.arrange:
arrange(
  [16, stack(drums, perc)],
  [16, stack(drums, perc, bass, chords)],
  [16, stack(drums, perc, bass, chords, lead)],
  [8, stack(chords, lead)],
  [8, stack(drums, perc, bass)],
)
